profile.headline: Avionics Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an Avionics Engineering Leader with experience in Commercial aircraft avionics. I have worked on Boeing and Airbus aircraft throughout my career.   

I provide airline and aircraft expertise to support and advise on Internal/External projects as well as issues regarding Avionics, Maintenance and Engineering, and Flight Ops Engineering processes. I remain vigilant on industry regulatory and technical challenges, and business value metrics to support business cases for product development and change within the broader airline operational environment. 

 I am keenly aware of Customers' needs and will expend every effort to meet their needs and expectations.

positions.title: Avionics Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for Atlas Air fleet aircraft software operations in regard to Electronic Storage, Distribution and Loading of aircraft software.  This includes Aircraft Cybersecurity and Aircraft Software configuration management programs, ARINC 645-1 secure dataloaders and aircraft components.

positions.title: Lead Avionics Engineer
positions.description:
▪	Coordinates Avionics Engineering efforts within the Atlas Air Technical Operations Teams.
▪	Lead Avionics Engineer for Avionics Engineering Team. Exercises control over major service items and various projects that have substantial schedule or cost impact. 
▪	Distributes tasks, provides reporting data and presentations to Manager of Avionics Engineering. 
▪	Manages the FDM program, AOG Service Items, Chronic and Repeat items, performs EO / FCD / AP / PAR lead reviews, oversees work quality and efficiency, and works to ensure Team engineers meet milestones and objectives. 
▪	Collaborates daily with Principal Avionics Engineers as well as fulfills role of Principal Engineer in their absence. 
▪	Develops cost savings initiatives working with OEM partners to reduce costs and improve component reliability.
▪	Performs vigorous monitoring of CFR Compliance as well as AD status for Avionics Engineering documents.

positions.title: Airline Operations Domain Specialist
positions.description: •	Responsible for Teledyne Controls Product Line, supporting various entities within Delta Air Lines Technical Operations Center in Atlanta, Georgia. Monitor Teledyne system performance for Boeing 737, 757, 767, 777 aircraft as well as Airbus A220, A320/321, and A350 aircraft. Monitor operation of and suggests airline improvements for Teledyne LSE Aircraft Software Management and Electronic Distribution system as well as PMAT 2000 and PMAT XS aircraft software loaders. Observes Teledyne related equipment for currency of Service Bulletins and applicable software updates.

positions.title: Manager, Avionics Engineering
positions.description:
•	Responsible for Safety, Compliance, Economics, and Reliability of the Avionics systems for a fleet of Boeing 737-300/-500/-700/-800 aircraft in a Part 121/135 operation.
•	Avionics systems within this discipline are: Head Up Guidance (HGS), Electrical Power, Autopilot, Communications, Navigation, Customer Broadband Internet, Flight Data and Voice Recorders, Onboard Network Systems (Ops Spec D301), Aircraft Software, Aircraft Displays (CDS), Aircraft Data Management (DFDR, CVR) Electronic Flight Bag, Aircraft Lighting, and associated aircraft wiring and power systems.
•	Responsible for Avionics related items from Continuing Analysis and Surveillance System (CASS) meetings.
•	Recurring qualified as a Head Up Guidance (HGS) Cat III Designated Trainer.
•	Coordinated with other departments (e.g., Flight Operations, Ground Operations, Inflight) to meet operational and human factors requirements.
•	Responsible for testing and compliance documentation for expanded Customer PED usage as outlined in 14 CFR 91.21 and 121.306 and InFO 13010SUP.

positions.title: Lead Avionics Engineer
positions.description:
•	Coordinated Avionics Engineering efforts within the Maintenance and Engineering department.
•	Developed cost savings initiatives working with OEM partners to reduce costs and improve component reliability.
•	Performed vigorous monitoring of CFR Compliance as well as AD status for Engineering generated documents.
•	Attended Reliability Control Board (RCB) meetings to discuss actionable items of analysis and trend data for the fleet.
•	Responsible for verifying the technical content of MEL/MMEL revisions.

positions.title: Avionics Engineer
positions.description:
•	Generate Aircraft Change Orders, Component Change Orders, and Engineering Drawings for a fleet of Boeing 737-200/-300/-500 aircraft.
•	Qualified HGS Installer for the Rockwell Collins Model 2300/2350/4000 series. Assisted in developing progressive Instructions for Continued Airworthiness (ICA) for HGS systems.
•	Assisted in developing User Guides for electronic aircraft software loaders.
•	Provide On-site Engineering Support for Heavy and Line Maintenance Facilities as well as OEM support for Line troubleshooting.
•	Member of Southwest Airlines Go Team.

courses.name: Basic Aircraft Accident Investigation - United States Department of Transportation

volunteerExperiences.description: I was blessed to participate in a build in Denton, Texas.  This has subsequently opened my eyes to the need for quality, low cost housing.  I expect to participate in other builds here in the Atlanta area soon!
